name: Kouhai to Kouhaii de Kouhai Shitemita.
original_name: 後輩と後背位で交配してみた。
source:
"Senpai, please embrace me!"
What would you do if your cute pet-like junior at school confessed her feelings to you?
"Boys embrace from behind."

This visual novel is born from that idea.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086640.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
“学长，请抱我！”
如果那名像宠物一样可爱的学妹突然向你告白，你会怎么做？
“男生应该从后面抱女生。”

本作便由这个想法诞生。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086640.html]DLsite[/url]]
